sources.title: A note on Youden's J and its cost ratio
sources.author: Niels Smits
sources.support: Equations7-9 express Youden criterion with inverse class prevalence contributions.
sources.usage_limit: Supports class-cost relationship only. Does not establish that weighted logistic loss will improve this dataset or validate H013.

our_derivation: For calibrated probability p and prevalence pi, the likelihood ratio is (p/(1-p))/ (pi/(1-pi)); equal conditional-class errors correspond to posterior threshold pi. Weighted logistic fit with offset logit(p)-logit(pi) represents a balanced posterior; prediction removes the fixed prior shift. Finite-model improvement remains empirical.
